question: Why do fools separate sankhya and yoga while the wise find one fruit?
premises: fools declare sankhya and yoga separate
one who abides rightly finds fruit of both
inference: sankhya and yoga are one recognition, not two rival paths
uncertainties: Kashmirian recension wording and Abhinava's Śaiva turn may differ from vulgate memory
plain_english: Fools call sankhya and yoga separate, but the wise do not; one who abides rightly obtains the fruit of both.
